theme.title: The 1980s Finals
theme.subtitle: Celtics, Lakers and 76ers
theme.recap: Boston and Los Angeles traded titles through the decade, including a Game 5 in a Boston Garden with no air conditioning.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: In the 1987 title clincher, the Lakers won the third quarter 30 to what?
questions.context: 1987 NBA Finals · Game 6 · at Los Angeles

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers outscored the Celtics 30–12 in the third quarter for an 18-point turnaround

funFacts.text: Boston reached the Finals with its bench depleted by injuries to Bill Walton and Scott Wedman.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their bench, an asset of the previous year's team, was decimated by injuries

funFacts.text: Magic Johnson had only four points at halftime before the Lakers seized control.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Magic Johnson had only four points at the half

funFacts.text: James Worthy dove for a loose ball, kept it inbounds and fed Magic for a momentum-changing dunk.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Worthy went to the floor, batted the ball inbounds to a breaking Magic Johnson

questions.prompt: Jamaal Wilkes scored a career high in the 1980 title clincher. How many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilkes had a career-high 37 points and added 10 rebounds.

funFacts.text: The Lakers had to play the title clincher without Kareem, whose ankle had been badly sprained.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar was the league's MVP, but midway through Game 5, the Lakers center suffered a severely sprained ankle

funFacts.text: Rookie Magic Johnson started at center and played all five positions during the closeout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: started the game at center and eventually played all five positions

funFacts.text: Much of the United States saw the decisive game on tape delay while CBS aired regular prime-time shows.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: So Game 6 was shown at 11:30pm Eastern (10:30pm Central) in all but eight US cities
